description:
Convert three advisory project invariants into durable, mechanically checked policy before the v1.0 release. Enforcement must catch regressions without confusing free-form prose with semantic identifiers, legitimate boundary adapters with domain representations, or deliberate migrations with permanent compatibility paths.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Required automated checks reject new raw-string representations of identities, constrained tokens, closed vocabularies, and protocol sentinels in production code outside explicitly identified parsing and serialization boundaries.
- [hard] REQ-02: Required automated checks reject superseded aliases, duplicate fields or representations, and compatibility branches outside a named, versioned migration boundary carrying a tracked removal condition; any accepted baseline is explicit, narrow, reviewable, and cannot grow silently.
- [hard] REQ-03: Required automated checks enforce inward dependency direction across applicable production workspaces: domain and graph remain pure and I/O-free, persistence stays behind storage interfaces, commands orchestrate inner layers, and CLI, output, server, MCP, and web adapters do not push boundary concerns inward.
- [hard] REQ-04: The enforcement inventory explicitly names every applicable production root; any omitted workspace or path has a local rationale, and no blanket directory or module exemption is accepted.
- [hard] REQ-05: Positive and negative regression fixtures prove representative compliant cases pass and representative violations of each invariant fail with actionable diagnostics naming the file and violated rule.
- [hard] REQ-06: The checks run on required repository gate paths used for v1.0 completion, and the current production tree passes after violations are fixed or captured by narrowly justified, non-growing exceptions.
- [hard] REQ-07: The semantic-types, canonical-cutover, and architecture-dependency-direction registry entries are promoted from advisory to enforced only after their durable checks exist, with each enforced-by reference resolving to the gate or rule that actually performs the check.
- [hard] REQ-08: Registry projections are regenerated, invariant/link validation is clean, and contributor guidance explains how to diagnose a failure and add an intentional versioned migration boundary without weakening the checks.
title: Enforce semantic types, canonical cutovers, and architecture dependency direction
